TSL Learning 06: Geometry Test (Point in Triangle)

Now let's do some actual geometry! We'll test if 2D points are inside a triangle. This is a building block for the edge clipping algorithm.

The Algorithm: Barycentric Coordinates

A point P is inside triangle ABC if it can be expressed as:
P = u*A + v*B + w*C where u + v + w = 1 and all are ≥ 0.

We use the cross product method: check which side of each edge the point is on. If it's on the same side for all three edges, it's inside.

The TSL Code

import * as THREE from 'three/webgpu';
import { Fn, instancedArray, instanceIndex, select } from 'three/tsl';

// Initialize WebGPU
const renderer = new THREE.WebGPURenderer();
await renderer.init();

// Triangle vertices (vec4 for alignment, using xy)
const triangleData = new Float32Array([
    0.5, 0.1, 0, 0,   // A
    0.15, 0.85, 0, 0, // B
    0.85, 0.85, 0, 0, // C
]);
const triangleBuffer = instancedArray(triangleData, 'vec4');

// Test points (vec4 for alignment, using xy)
const pointsData = new Float32Array([...]);  // your points
const pointsBuffer = instancedArray(pointsData, 'vec4');

// Results: 1 if inside, 0 if outside
const resultsBuffer = instancedArray(new Uint32Array(numPoints), 'uint');

// Point-in-triangle test kernel
const pointInTriangle = Fn(() => {
    const point = pointsBuffer.element(instanceIndex).xy;
    const a = triangleBuffer.element(0).xy;
    const b = triangleBuffer.element(1).xy;
    const c = triangleBuffer.element(2).xy;

    // Sign function: which side of edge (a,b) is point p on?
    const sign = (px, py, ax, ay, bx, by) => {
        return (px.sub(bx)).mul(ay.sub(by)).sub((ax.sub(bx)).mul(py.sub(by)));
    };

    const d1 = sign(point.x, point.y, a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y);
    const d2 = sign(point.x, point.y, b.x, b.y, c.x, c.y);
    const d3 = sign(point.x, point.y, c.x, c.y, a.x, a.y);

    // Inside if all signs are same (all ≥0 or all ≤0)
    const hasNeg = d1.lessThan(0).or(d2.lessThan(0)).or(d3.lessThan(0));
    const hasPos = d1.greaterThan(0).or(d2.greaterThan(0)).or(d3.greaterThan(0));
    const inside = hasNeg.and(hasPos).not();

    resultsBuffer.element(instanceIndex).assign(select(inside, 1, 0));
})().compute(numPoints);

// Execute
await renderer.computeAsync(pointInTriangle);

// Read results
const gpuBuffer = await renderer.getArrayBufferAsync(resultsBuffer.value);
const results = new Uint32Array(gpuBuffer);
